  const lastResponseType = configuration.responseType ?? undefined;

  return {
    allowedRoleIds: [...roleIds],
    allowedShift: ['ALL'],
    appName,
    behaviorOnDismissal: isManualTrigger

      : parseDismissalBehavior(

    isCommentRequired: configuration.commentRequired,

    redisplayInterval: redisplayDays === undefined ? 'NEVER' : 'CUSTOM',

export async function collectCascadeDeleteOrder(
  equipmentRepository: Repository<Equipment>,
  rootId: number,
): Promise<Array<number>> {
  const rows = await equipmentRepository.query(
    `WITH equipment_tree AS (
      SELECT
        equipment.id,
        equipment.parent_equipment_id,
        0 AS depth
      FROM isa95.equipment AS equipment
      WHERE equipment.id = @0

      UNION ALL

      SELECT
        child.id,
        child.parent_equipment_id,
        tree.depth + 1 AS depth
      FROM isa95.equipment AS child
      INNER JOIN equipment_tree AS tree
        ON child.parent_equipment_id = tree.id
    )
    SELECT id
    FROM equipment_tree
    ORDER BY depth DESC, id DESC
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)`,
    [rootId],
  );

  return rows.map(({ id }: { id: number | string }) => Number(id));
}
